title: Corporate UGC Creator / Social Media Content Creator (m/w/d)
description: Wir, die Lakefields GmbH, sind ein junges und solides Unternehmen, welches mit viel Wissen und Liebe zum Detail Hunde- und Katzenfutter aus besten regionalen Zutaten vom Bodensee selbst produziert. Mit über 75 Mitarbeitern und knapp 3.000m² Produktionsfläche fertigen wir Premiumprodukte in Lebensmittelqualität. Als Teil unseres Teams hast du die Möglichkeit, in einer dynamischen und wachsenden Branche zu arbeiten und deine Fähigkeiten unter Beweis zu stellen und weiterzuentwickeln. Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl, hast ein Gespür für Social Media und kannst andere mit deiner Begeisterung anstecken? Tiere liegen dir am Herzen und du hast Lust, unsere Produkte, unsere Arbeit und die Menschen dahinter authentisch zu zeigen? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen! Aufgaben Deine Rolle bei uns Als Corporate UGC Creator wirst du zu einem sichtbaren Gesicht unserer Marke. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team authentische Videos für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle – nahbar, kreativ und passend zu unserer Community. Dabei bist du regelmäßig bei uns in Gottmadingen, besuchst unsere Lieferanten und entdeckst mit der Kamera besondere Orte, Menschen und Geschichten rund um den Bodensee. Uns ist wichtig, dass du offen, neugierig und zuverlässig bist, gern vor der Kamera stehst und Freude daran hast, gute Geschichten in kurzen Videos zu erzählen. Das erwartet dich: Du stehst selbst vor der Kamera und präsentierst unsere Produkte auf natürliche und sympathische Weise. Du entwickelst Ideen und Formate für Reels, TikToks, Stories und weitere Social-Media-Inhalte. Du filmst bei uns in Gottmadingen, bei unseren Lieferanten und an passenden Locations rund um den Bodensee. Du gibst Einblicke hinter die Kulissen und stellst Produkte, Menschen, Tiere und Geschichten aus unserem Unternehmensalltag vor. Du greifst aktuelle Social-Media-Trends auf und übersetzt sie passend für unsere Marke. Du produzierst unkomplizierten, authentischen Content – vom spontanen Handyvideo bis zum geplanten Format. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing- und Social-Media-Team zusammen. Du übernimmst die gesamte Video-Planung, -Umsetzung und auch den Schnitt sowie die Aufbereitung der Videos. Qualifikation Das bringst du mit: Du wohnst am Bodensee und kannst unseren Firmenstandort in Gottmadingen und verschiedene Orte in der Region regelmäßig gut erreichen. Du bist offen, kommunikativ und nicht kamerascheu. Du wirkst vor der Kamera natürlich und hast Lust, dich als Persönlichkeit einzubringen. Du interessierst dich ehrlich für unsere Produkte und möchtest dich intensiv mit ihnen beschäftigen. Du bist tierlieb und fühlst dich im Umgang mit Tieren wohl. Du nutzt Social Media aktiv und verstehst, welche Inhalte auf Instagram, TikTok und Co. funktionieren. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Sprache, Bild, Trends und unterhaltsames Storytelling. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und gut organisiert. Du bist bereit, regelmäßig für Drehs in der Region unterwegs zu sein. Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Content Creation, UGC, Social Media, Moderation, Schauspiel oder Video sind willkommen. Auch Quereinsteiger:innen mit der richtigen Ausstrahlung, Kreativität und Motivation passen gut zu uns. Benefits Das bieten wir dir: Eine kreative Aufgabe mit viel Raum für eigene Ideen Die Möglichkeit, ein prägendes Gesicht unserer Marke zu werden Abwechslungsreiche Drehs statt eines reinen Schreibtischjobs Spannende Einblicke in unsere Produkte, unsere Lieferanten und ihre Geschichten Arbeit mit Tieren sowie an besonderen Orten rund um den Bodensee Kurze Abstimmungswege und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketing-Team Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten Moderne Arbeitsmittel und technisches Equipment Klingt nach dir? Dann schick uns bitte keinen langen, förmlichen Roman. Wir möchten vor allem einen authentischen Eindruck von dir bekommen. Sende uns: deinen Lebenslauf Links zu bisherigen Social-Media-Inhalten oder passende Arbeitsproben ein kurzes Vorstellungsvideo mit dem Smartphone: Erzähl uns im Video einfach, wer du bist, was dich an unserer Marke und unseren Produkten interessiert und warum du Lust auf diese Rolle hast. Perfekte Beleuchtung und professioneller Schnitt sind nicht nötig - wir möchten dich kennenlernen und verstehen, warum du zu uns passt! Arbeitsort: Gottmadingen und Bodenseeregion Arbeitsmodell: [Teilzeit/Vollzeit/Werkstudent:in/Freelance] Start: ab sofort Wir freuen uns auf deine Persönlichkeit, deine Ideen und deine Sicht auf unsere Marke. description: <h2>Join us as a Senior Vehicle Security Engineer (all genders) and help safeguard the future of autonomous mobility at MOIA!</h2> <p>At MOIA, vehicle security is a cornerstone of trust in autonomous mobility. As a Senior Vehicle Security Engineer you’ll be part of a dedicated team that ensures our autonomous mobility platform is</p> <p>secure, resilient, and compliant with mobility industry standards. You’ll work across the full product lifecycle of our fully autonomous vehicles like the ID.Buzz AD—from concept to deployment and operations—designing and implementing cybersecurity strategies that protect our users, vehicles, and infrastructure.</p> <p>We’re looking for someone who thrives in cross-functional environments, understands the nuances of embedded systems and distributed architectures, and can translate complex threat models into actionable engineering requirements.</p> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Define cybersecurity concepts</strong> and system boundaries for autonomous mobility features, considering real-world operating environments.</li> <li><strong>Conduct threat analysis and risk assessments (TARA) </strong>in alignment with ISO/SAE 21434, identifying vulnerabilities and evaluating attack feasibility.</li> <li><strong>Translate TARA outcomes into security requirements</strong> and risk mitigation strategies.</li> <li>Collaborate with engineering and safety teams to <strong>embed security into every stage of the product lifecycle</strong>—from design and development to incident response.</li> <li><strong>Ensure ongoing compliance</strong> with cybersecurity standards across multiple projects.</li> <li>Partner with functional safety experts to align cybersecurity and safety requirements.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What will help you to fulfill your role&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Physics, or a related field.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with threat modeling and risk assessments for embedded or distributed systems.</li> <li>Familiarity with security best practices including secure communications, authentication protocols, and modern security technologies.</li> <li>Experience working with regulated environments and producing compliance-driven deliverables.</li> <li>Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across disciplines to define and negotiate security requirements.</li> <li>Several years in a cybersecurity or related engineering role, ideally in automotive or mobility domains.</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing security features in software or hardware systems.</li> <li>Familiarity with ISO/SAE 21434 and/or UNR 155 certification processes.</li> <li>Exposure to policy-driven security frameworks (e.g., RBAC/ABAC, OPA).</li> <li>Prior involvement in incident response, SLO/SLI definition, or on-call rotations.</li> <li>A passion for mentoring and leading technical discussions.</li> <li>Business-level fluency in English, both written and spoken</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds<em> </em>— even if you don’t meet every requirement. raw.description:
Deine Karriere

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen, flexiblen Senior Software Architect – idealerweise mit Full-Stack-Hintergrund – der uns bei der Konzeption und Architektur komplexer Business-Anwendungen unterstützt und sich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS und/oder Azure bewegt.

Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht.

Wir arbeiten in einer dynamischen und sich ständig verändernden Welt. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und sich schnell auf neue Situationen einstellen können. Eigeninitiative, technischer Weitblick und die Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln, sind uns dabei genauso wichtig wie ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang im Team.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Konzeption und Architektur moderner Softwarelösungen – von der Anforderungsanalyse über Architekturentscheidungen bis zur produktiven Umsetzung

  • Identifikation und architektonische Einbindung von KI-gestützten Features oder Use Cases, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll und wirtschaftlich tragfähig sind

  • Technologische Beratung unserer Kunden bei Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen
  • Sicherstellung von Code-Qualität und Architekturstandards durch Clean Code, Tests, Reviews und Best Practices
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung neuer technologischer Themenfelder – insbesondere im wachsenden Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz


Dein Profil

  • Selbstständige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise mit stark ausgeprägten analytischen und konzeptionellen Fähigkeiten

Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from&nbsp;<strong>more than one million investors</strong> which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.</p></div><p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>Team</strong></span></p> <p>The Risk Controlling department is responsible for establishing and maintaining a robust, group-wide risk management framework aligned with Basel principles and guidelines. This involves implementing policies and controls to identify, measure, monitor, and manage the bank's risks, including credit, market, operational, and liquidity risk. The team's primary functions are ongoing risk profile monitoring, preparing accurate risk reports for stakeholders and regulators, and assessing capital and liquidity adequacy according to regulatory frameworks like CRR.</p> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>As a Quantitative Risk Controller, you will play a central role in the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of the bank’s economic ICAAP framework, market price risk measurement, and liquidity risk analysis. risk transparency, regulatory compliance, and financial resilience.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and maintain models and methodologies for the economic perspective of ICAAP, including internal capital calculations and risk aggregation.</li> <li>Perform quantification and monitoring of market price risks (especially interest rate risk) using both standard and internal models.</li> <li>Analyze and report on liquidity risk metrics, including survival horizons, funding concentration, and liquidity stress testing.</li> <li>Conduct scenario analyses and stress tests for economic capital and liquidity risks, ensuring alignment with MaRisk and EBA/ECB guidelines.</li> <li>Maintain the risk inventory and contribute to the assessment of material risks in coordination with other risk types.</li> <li>Support ICAAP reporting to management, regulators, and internal committees, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and compliance.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Treasury, Finance, and the business lines to align capital, liquidity, and risk strategies.</li> <li>Monitor regulatory developments and adapt internal methodologies accordingly.</li> <li>Contribute to the ongoing refinement of risk measurement tools and data quality improvements.<strong><br></strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Profile</strong></p> <p>To succeed in this role, you will need a combination of quantitative expertise, regulatory understanding, and communication skills to support sound risk-based steering and regulatory compliance.</p> <p><strong>Key Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in a quantitative discipline or Business Administration with a quantitative focus.</li> <li>2–5 years of experience in risk controlling, quantitative analysis, or related roles in banking or financial services.</li> <li>Proven knowledge of economic capital models, ICAAP methodology (economic perspective), and capital aggregation techniques.</li> <li>Strong understanding of market risk measurement (e.g., VaR, sensitivities, stress testing) and liquidity risk metrics.</li> <li>Familiarity with MaRisk, Basel III/IV, and ECB ICAAP guidelines.</li> <li>Solid experience with Excel/VBA and analytical tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or SQL).</li> <li>Ability to analyze complex data sets and translate results into meaningful risk insights.</li> <li>Strong documentation and reporting skills to support transparency and auditability.</li> <li>High level of independence, analytical thinking, and precision.</li> <li>Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across departments and present risk topics to senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, or similar are an advantage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!</strong></p> <p>At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.</p> <p>As part of our team, you will benefit from:</p> <ul> <li>Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.</li> <li>Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.</li> <li>A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.</li> <li>Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.&nbsp;</li> <li>Do you miss being in the office? title: Senior Software Engineer - Security Libraries
description: <h2>About Datadog</h2> <p>We're on a mission to build the best platform in the world for engineers to understand and scale their systems, applications, and teams. We operate at high scale with trillions of data points per day, enabling seamless collaboration and problem-solving among Dev, Ops, and Security teams for tens of thousands of companies globally. Our engineering culture values pragmatism, honesty, and simplicity to solve hard problems the right way.</p> <h2>The Team</h2> <p>The Datadog Security Libraries team owns the customer-side integrations behind our run-time security products <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/product/app-and-api-protection/">App &amp; API Protection</a>, <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/product/workload-protection/">Workload Protection</a>, and <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/product/code-security/">Code Security</a>. Our libraries let customers automatically manage application security risk with continuous, real-time monitoring of vulnerabilities and threats against their web applications, serverless applications, and APIs, in production. Automatically integrated with <a href="https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/">Application Performance Monitoring</a> (APM) distributed tracing and code-level context, our software empowers development, operations, and security teams to build and run secure applications.</p> <p>As a polyglot team we ship and maintain the security capabilities of Datadog's tracing libraries across <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-dotnet"><strong>.NET</strong></a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-java"><strong>Java</strong></a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go"><strong>Go</strong></a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js"><strong>Node.js</strong></a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-py"><strong>Python</strong></a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-ruby"><strong>Ruby</strong></a><strong>, and </strong><a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-php"><strong>PHP</strong></a>, on top of a shared C++ core and a set of HTTP proxy integrations (primarily Envoy, NGINX, and HAProxy). Our code runs inside thousands of production applications around the world. Recent work spans exploit prevention (RASP) and WAF detections, API Security, code security (IAST and SCA), and AI-assisted ("agentic") onboarding, always measured by real product outcomes and operational telemetry.</p> <h2>The Opportunity</h2> <p>We're looking for a <strong>senior, polyglot engineer</strong> to contribute across several of our security libraries, with <strong>.NET or Java</strong> expertise. You'll design and build security integrations and detection features, take them from prototype to production-hardened, and own them operationally as they instrument thousands of applications.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>As a senior engineer within a product team, we also expect a strong sense of <strong>product engineering</strong>: you connect the libraries you build to customer adoption and security value, and you help decide what's worth building.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and own security integrations and detections (WAF, RASP/exploit prevention, API Security, IAST, SCA) across multiple libraries, with <strong>.NET and/or Java as your primary focus</strong>.</li> <li>Take projects from prototype to deployed, correct, operable, and maintainable, writing code that safely instruments thousands of applications in production.</li> <li>Own your systems operationally: monitor production telemetry (e.g., WAF/RASP timeouts, performance and cost), debug challenging cross-system issues, and drive down customer-facing problems.</li> <li>Shape the roadmap: help define the OKRs for the systems you own, break features into components other engineers can build in parallel, and drive designs and RFCs to alignment across our security library teams.</li> <li>Partner with product management, backend, and frontend teams to turn product ideas,&nbsp; new detections, agentic onboarding, API security,&nbsp; into capabilities customers actually adopt.</li> <li>Mentor teammates and act as a force multiplier: raise the bar on code quality and testing, and make the whole team more effective than you'd be on your own.</li> <li>Represent Datadog in the relevant language and security communities.</li> </ul> <h2>What We're Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>You are an <strong>expert in at least one of .NET (C#) or Java</strong>, and you're a <strong>polyglot</strong> who can contribute idiomatically across other libraries when needed with the support of their main maintainers. For each language you use, you write clean, correct, well-tested, performant, idiomatic code.</li> <li>You have <strong>strong software-engineering fundamentals</strong>: you consistently ship modular, maintainable code with little guidance, and you leave code in substantially better shape than you found it.</li> <li>You have a <strong>product-engineering mindset</strong>: you care about user experience and product outcomes as much as the code, weigh technical trade-offs against customer impact, and help decide what to build,&nbsp; not just how.</li> <li>You have experience <strong>building and shipping libraries or SDKs</strong> consumed by other developers, and you understand packaging, versioning, and backward compatibility.</li> <li>You care about <strong>performance and cost</strong>, in both time and space, and you have experience measuring and optimizing to that end.</li> <li>You are <strong>operationally mature</strong>: you take full accountability for what you ship in production, even when others work on it.</li> <li>You <strong>communicate clearly</strong> in writing and in person,&nbsp; you drive alignment through RFCs and informal collaboration, give bad news early, and give constructive, empathetic feedback to peers.</li> <li>You have a BS/MS/PhD in a STEM field or equivalent experience.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Deep expertise across <strong>.NET or Java</strong>, including familiarity with <strong>language runtime internals and instrumentation</strong>, the JVM, bytecode instrumentation and Java agents; or the CLR/JIT/GC, IL rewriting, and DiagnosticSource/EventPipe in .NET.</li> <li>A track record of shipping across several of our languages (Go, Node.js, Python, Ruby, PHP, C/C++).</li> <li>An <strong>application security</strong> background: WAF, RASP, SAST/IAST/SCA, threat detection, or secure-by-design practices.</li> <li>Experience with <strong>auto-instrumentation, APM/distributed tracing, or code telemetry and introspection</strong>.</li> <li>A history of <strong>maintaining open-source projects</strong>, with public projects or published packages (e.g., NuGet, Maven).</li> <li>Experience with <strong>AI-assisted developer tooling or agentic workflows</strong>.</li> <li>A developer-experience or customer-support sensibility.</li> </ul> <p style="color: white;">#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on <a href="https://www.instagram.com/datadoghq/?hl=en" target="_blank">Instagram</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/datadog" target="_blank">LinkedIn,</a> and <a href="https://learn.datadoghq.com/" target="_blank">Datadog Learning Center. </a></p> <hr> <p data-renderer-start-pos="215"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Equal Opportunity at Datadog:</strong></p> <p>Datadog is proud to offer <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf" target="_blank">equal employment opportunity</a> to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities

Von Köln aus erreichen wir jeden Monat hunderttausende Golfbegeisterte in sieben Sprachen — und wir arbeiten mit dem wohl modernsten KI-Setup im Sportjournalismus: Bei uns schreibt die KI die Artikel. Du entscheidest, welche Geschichten erzählt werden.

Deshalb suchen wir keinen klassischen Redakteur. Wir suchen dich: jemanden, der Golf liebt, Themen riecht, Menschen vor die Kamera bekommt und Dinge organisiert kriegt. Du gibst Themen frei, holst die spannendsten Gesprächspartner ins Interview und machst daraus Videos, Shorts und Podcast-Momente, die die Golf-Community feiert.

Für den Ausbau unseres Teams suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Vollzeit — als Trainee, Praktikant/in oder im dualen Studium. Standort Köln, hybrides Arbeiten möglich.

Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst unsere KI-Content-Pipeline: Du erkennst, welche Themen zünden, gibst Artikel frei und gibst der KI die Richtung vor — Human in the Loop, du hast das letzte Wort.
  • Du organisierst Interviews und Gesprächspartner: Spieler, Trainer, Club-Persönlichkeiten, Marken — du baust dir dein Netzwerk in der Golfszene auf.
  • Du produzierst Bewegtbild: kurze Video-Interviews, Shorts für Social Media, Podcast-Formate. Kamera-Erfahrung ist super, Lust zu lernen reicht — die KI hilft dir bei Schnitt, Untertiteln und Aufbereitung.
  • Du planst die Themenwoche mit unseren Werkstudenten und wächst Schritt für Schritt in die redaktionelle Steuerung hinein.
  • Du bist bei Turnieren und Events dabei — vor Ort, mit Kamera und Mikro.

Qualifikation

  • Du spielst selbst Golf. Das ist bei dieser Rolle Voraussetzung — deine Leidenschaft für den Sport ist der Filter, den keine KI ersetzen kann.
  • Du hast dein Studium (fast) abgeschlossen oder suchst ein duales Modell — und du willst Vollzeit einsteigen, nicht nebenbei.
  • Du bist Organisator: Du sprichst Menschen an, machst Termine klar und behältst zehn Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft.
  • Du hast Spaß an Video und Social-Formaten — vor oder hinter der Kamera.
  • Du bist neugierig auf KI-Tools und willst lernen, wie ein Medienunternehmen 2026 wirklich arbeitet.
  • Du schreibst und sprichst sicher auf Deutsch, Englisch ist von Vorteil.

Benefits

  • Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins — und ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Nach der Einarbeitung übernimmst du die operative Content-Steuerung. Dir stehen alle Wege offen — gute Leute lassen wir nicht gehen.
  • Das modernste KI-Setup im Sportjournalismus — du lernst Workflows, die andere Redaktionen erst in Jahren haben werden.
  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Freiraum für deine Ideen — du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründer.
  • Pressereisen an die schönsten Golf-Orte der Welt und neues (Test-)Equipment für besonders engagierte Teammitglieder.
  • Ein tolles Büro direkt im Zentrum von Köln — flexible Zeiten, hybrides Arbeiten möglich.
  • Golf-Perks: Golf Post Premium, Einladungen zu Turnieren und Branchenevents.

DIR GEFÄLLT, WAS DU LIEST?

Bewirb dich jetzt unter jobs at golfpost .de und werde Teil unseres Teams! Dein Ansprechpartner ist Matthias.

title: Account Director - Comms Planning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>626 - Account Director – Comms Planning</strong></p> <p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.</p> <p>WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com</p> <p><strong>About EssenceMediacom: A Leading WPP Media Brand</strong></p> <p><strong><u>EssenceMediacom:</u></strong></p> <p>EssenceMediacom is a new breed of media agency. Grounded in analytics &amp; insights and powered by data &amp; technology, we believe in the power of media and creative to drive breakthroughs for the world’s best brands. We help clients understand the modern marketing paradox and discover the breakthroughs brands need to win with their consumers. We are designed for the new communications economy — built on data &amp; technology, built for people &amp; algorithms, built around diverse schools of thought, built to test &amp; learn at scale, and, crucially, built to evolve.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>The role is with TUI - the UK's leading integrated tourism group. TUI offers everything from sun-drenched beach breaks and exhilarating cruises to bespoke tours and family-friendly resorts. They are a brand that consistently pushes boundaries, embracing digital transformation and sustainable practices to redefine what a modern holiday means.<br>&nbsp;<br>This is a high-profile, high-spending account where your contributions will be highly visible and valued, working in an exciting and fast-moving sector.<br>&nbsp;<br>The role includes planning across the full suite of offline and online channels, spanning TV, OOH, Print, Radio, Digital Audio, Display, Video &amp; Paid Social, as well as bigger brand partnerships that create unique and impactful campaigns.</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP &amp; WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be&nbsp;<strong>Extraordinary</strong>&nbsp;by&nbsp;<em>Leading Collectively</em>&nbsp;to&nbsp;<em>Inspire transformational Creativity.</em></li> <li>Create an&nbsp;<strong>Open</strong>&nbsp;environment by<em>&nbsp;Balancing People and Client Experiences</em>&nbsp;by&nbsp;<em>Cultivating Trust</em>.</li> <li>Lead&nbsp;<strong>Optimistically</strong>&nbsp;by&nbsp;<em>Championing Growth</em>&nbsp;<em>and Development</em>&nbsp;to&nbsp;<em>Mobilize the Enterprise</em>.</li> <li>Strong management and client relationship skills</li> <li>People management skills to support AD in the management and development of Planners and Execs</li> <li>Solution focused mindset</li> <li>Enthusiasm, curiosity, and a team player mentality</li> <li>Self-motivated; an ambition to make the ordinary extraordinary</li> <li>A thirst to learn – be that the client’s business, people, brands, industry, trends etc</li> <li>An ability to prioritise and delegate, as well as manage both up and down</li> <li>Empathetic and self-aware</li> <li>Motivated to drive business results for both client &amp; EssenceMediacom</li> <li>Positive, proactive approach to problem solving</li> <li>Calm under pressure</li> <li>Accurate verbal and written feedback and instructions</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are dedicated to revolutionizing how accounting and finance teams work, enabling them to move beyond manual, tedious tasks and into a strategic, advisory role. By leveraging our groundbreaking, auditable AI Agents and purpose-built solutions, we empower teams to streamline their financial close, enhance compliance, and achieve a new level of transparency and accuracy. Our mission is to help accountants reclaim their time, simplify their work, and ultimately shape the future of their profession. Come join us! FloQast's SAP integration is central to making FloQast the home base for accountants at SAP-running companies. You will own the product strategy and execution for that integration - ensuring FloQast workflows, playbooks, and products run cleanly on SAP data and processes. You will operate at the intersection of deep SAP technical knowledge and accounting domain expertise, working across Product, Engineering, customers, and GTM to drive adoption and expand FloQast's footprint in the SAP ecosystem. Visa sponsorship is NOT available at this time What You'll Do Define and drive product functionality for FloQast's SAP integration, ensuring FloQast workflows, playbooks, and products are fully enabled by SAP financial data and processes. Own the end-to-end integration design: connectivity patterns, data extraction methods (ABAP, oData, BTP), and how SAP financial data maps into FloQast's canonical models. Navigate SAP deployment models — On-Premise, Private Cloud, Public Cloud (RISE/GROW), and HEC - to ensure FloQast's integration strategy covers the full range of customer environments. Translate SAP FI-CO process knowledge (period-end close, subledger reconciliation, journal entries, controlling) into FloQast product requirements and integration designs. As the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for vessel and company data, you will be the driving force behind data excellence, ensuring our information remains a trusted foundation for decision-making across the maritime industry.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Commercial teams, you will have the opportunity to influence how maritime data is collected, managed, and delivered -turning industry knowledge into solutions that create real value for our customers.

If you are passionate about maritime intelligence, data quality, and building high-performing teams, this is your opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-growing global company.

Your mission is to:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of data analysts, fostering growth, ownership, and continuous improvement.

  • Act as the subject matter expert on Vessel Particulars & Companies business logic, rules, and datasets.

  • Identify and integrate new datasets into our databases.

  • Develop and test business logic, create dashboards, and curate datasets.

  • Allocate resources, support team members, and identify training needs.

  • Implement automation solutions, integrate new data sources, and maintain related platforms.

  • Collaborate with tech stakeholders for infrastructure needs and support commercial teams with data insights.

  • Enhance proprietary data quality and keep the team aligned with company objectives.

  • Manage KPIs and OKRs, provide insights for improvement, and support product development.
